title: ResearchPlanSchema
description: Contract for structured research planning before live web or knowledge retrieval (ADR-027)

topic.description: Full topic or title assignment of the technical article

blog_type.description: Canonical blog type strictly referenced from 00_SKILL/BLOG_TAXONOMY_CANONICAL_v1.0.md

research_objective.description: Primary engineering objective and technical scope of this research plan

research_questions.description: Granular technical questions that decompose the overall topic into verifiable sub-problems

rq_id.description: Unique research question identifier formatted as RQ-xxx

question.description: Specific technical question to be answered by authoritative sources

priority.description: Priority level; HIGH questions must be ANSWERED or explicitly BLOCKED for plan completion

preferred_source_types.description: Target source types (e.g., MANUAL, STANDARD, DATASHEET)

preferred_publishers.description: Target manufacturers, standards bodies or institutions (e.g., ABB, Siemens, IEEE)

freshness_required.description: Whether latest edition/firmware/standard is required (true) or stable fundamentals suffice (false)

status.description: Current resolution status of this research question

block_reason.description: Required rationale if status is BLOCKED
